reviews.text: Good honest vetinarians who care about the pet clients than fattening the bottom line.

Extremely Disappointing Experience — I Would Not Recommend This Clinic

I strongly recommend that pet owners carefully consider their options before choosing this clinic, particularly when it comes to Dr. Moonjal and Dr. Parham. Unfortunately, my experience was profoundly disappointing.

I am someone who is more than willing to invest in the health and well-being of my beloved senior dog. Over the years, I have spent thousands of dollars on his medical care, including surgeries, dental treatments, and other procedures at excellent veterinary clinics in Vancouver and elsewhere. I have consistently had positive experiences with other veterinarians and have always felt that the care, professionalism, communication, and treatment my dog received justified the cost. In many cases, I was actually happy to pay more because I felt my dog was genuinely being cared for.

This experience was completely different.

From the cleanliness and overall environment of the clinic to the way my dog and I were treated, I found the experience extremely concerning. The reception staff were, in my experience, rude and unprofessional, and I did not feel that the level of communication or respect was appropriate for a veterinary practice.

Most importantly, I was left with the impression that the focus was on the financial aspect of veterinary care rather than thoughtful, individualized care for an elderly animal. I did not feel that there was a clear strategy, adequate attention to my dog’s individual needs, or the level of compassion and professionalism I have experienced elsewhere.

Animals are vulnerable patients who cannot speak for themselves. They deserve patience, careful handling, appropriate medical judgment, and genuine compassion. Their owners also deserve transparent communication, respect, and confidence that recommendations are being made with the animal’s best interests at heart.

As a physician myself, professional ethics and putting the well-being of a patient first are principles I take very seriously. That made this experience particularly upsetting for me.

I have had wonderful experiences with other veterinarians, and I know what high-quality veterinary care can look like. Unfortunately, this was not that experience.

Based on my personal experience, I would not return to this clinic and would encourage pet owners to thoroughly research other options before entrusting their animals to this practice.
Thanks!! Susana for trusting us

We brought in our 11 year old cat for the first time to this clinic. As soon as Dr. Parham walked in, i was overcome with a wave of relief from his calm and gentle demeanor. He took his time reviewing her x-rays and chart from our old vet.  I did not feel any pressure from upselling and I trust everything Dr. Parham recommended.

When we moved to the Dunbar neighbourhood, I started taking my 13 year old dog to Alta Vista Animal Hospital. The service I have received there has been exceptional. They find time to see my dog on short notice and the team has fixed his allergy issues. Alongside this, I just had surgery myself and could not get the dog food home, the team helped me carry it 2 blocks to my house :) Amazing place, I highly recommend Alta Vista.

I’ve worked at a vet clinic before, and unfortunately, it wasn’t the greatest experience. I witnessed situations that made me feel like money was sometimes prioritized over genuinely caring for the animals, so I was really nervous about bringing my boy to a new vet for the first time.

However, my experience at Alta Vista with Dr. Parham was completely different. He was amazing. I never once felt pressured to pay for unnecessary tests or treatments, and it truly felt like he cared about my boy and wanted what was best for him.

Sake was already feeling so much better the very next day, and I was so relieved and happy that I decided to bring him in. Thank you so much to Dr. Parveen and the entire team.

Dr.Mandhu-Gill did an excellent examination of my 13 year old cat [VOKRA adoptee] and listened and considered the data i shared thoroughly and effectively.  i felt heard and seen during a 1st time flea scare/health scare combo. reasonable costs and will work with you if you have barriers to full care options

It's taken me awhile to write this review because it's been too painful to think about but I really want to share my experience with anyone who might be in the same spot as i was.  I am so thankful for this clinic and to Dr. Parham for his assistance with laying my boy Riley to rest.  Losing your beloved pet is one of the hardest times we as pet parents will ever have to face.  I lost my boy on a Sunday when our regular vet clinic was closed.  He started to decline so rapidly that I couldn't allow him to suffer even one more night.  So I was in a position to recieve assistance from a vet I had never met.  But i honesty could not have asked for a more wonderful person to help us on that day.  Dr. Parham is a beautiful person with a warm, gentle demeanor and a compassionate heart. He was so caring with me and Riley and throughout the process his carefully chosen words brought me peace and strength in a very difficult time.  He is a great vet and lovely person.  I recommend him completely 100%.  Thank you Dr. Parham for being there for us ❤️

My cat now is 5 years old and I have been to too many vets with my cat. I decide to settle down with my cat and choose alta vista! Truly because Dr.Munjal is a very professional and experienced vet. And all the staff at the hospital are kind, helpful and precious. This is by far the best vet in Vancouver!my cat and I are very happy with them.

❗️❗️❗️Brought our kitten in for vaccines and asked the vet to check a suspicious hairless patch that looked like ringworm. We specifically requested a Wood’s lamp exam. The concern was dismissed and we were told everything was fine.

Went to another clinic for a second opinion, and the lesion immediately fluoresced under the Wood’s lamp and was diagnosed as likely ringworm. 😐

Very disappointing experience. We trusted the vet’s assessment and could have delayed treatment if we hadn’t sought another opinion ourselves. 👎
Extremely knowledgeable and just as kind ! Our cats were getting a really good attention and kindness from all the staff!
Great staff and service

I had a great experience at Alta Vista Animal Hospital. The reception staff were very welcoming and friendly. The doctors explained every situation related to my cat clearly and in a very professional way. They are respectful, knowledgeable, and you can really feel their experience. I truly appreciate their care and dedication. Their prices are also very competitive compared to the market. Highly recommended!
Knowledgeable, kind, caring staff. Great hours. Reasonable prices. Overall great experiences.

A great location in Central Dunbar!! Alta Vista Animal Hospital has a GREAT team of staff!! Eknoor and Serene helped me care for my sick cat with kidney disease. Cat was 17 years old and we managed him for two months. My Mom and I made the painful decision to put our cat to sleep here at the end. Dr. Pazdezh and Dr. Munjal are very kind and helpful veteranarians!! I can't recommend this place enough!! I'm very grateful I found them. When we get another pet we will probably come back. Thank you Alta Vista Team. 🙏
Great clinic, everyone is so kind, they handled my old man kitty with such care. I truly appreciate it ❤️

I’ve been coming to this clinic with my Siberian cat for a couple of years and have generally had good experiences. However, today’s visit was extremely upsetting.

I came in for an emergency because my male cat had not urinated in over 16 hours and was covered in his own diarrhea when I got home from work. When I tried to clean him, he showed significant pain and distress. Multiple vets, including this office—have warned me in the past that urinary blockage in male cats is life-threatening and an emergency.
When I explained the situation at the front desk, the staff member responded with visible annoyance and asked, “Did you even call?” There was no expression of concern, no empathy, no acknowledgment of how stressful the situation was, and not even a question about my cat—his name/my name, nothing. When I said I hadn’t called because I believed this was an emergency and rushed over, he replied, “Well, we have other patients too,” then rolled his eyes and sighed.
I was honestly shocked. I wasn’t expecting them to cancel others for me but atleast check with doc, check-in with me? Ask me questions? Take some additional history and just say words of comfort? What healthcare professional rolls their eyes and sighs at someone who is clearly distressed and seeking help for their pet baby? There was zero compassion. He then said, “I’ll add you in today, but next time don’t come without calling.” At that point, I walked away.
I am a dentist, and I cannot imagine ever treating a patient, or allowing my front desk staff to treat a patient, in a possible emergency situation with such dismissiveness and lack of basic kindness. Technical care aside, compassion and professionalism matter. Took my baby 5 mins down the road to Dunbar Animal Hospital who were more that happy to see him, took immediate care of him and above all treated us with basic kindness and empathy.
We have been taking our cats and dogs here for 15+ years. Such great Drs and staff here. We also get our Vet approved pet food and treats here.

(Be careful — the owner will try to claim the bad reviews are for the wrong store.) Save your pet, save your wallet, go somewhere else.

This place had the lowest routine check cost ($50 something), and the worst vet. The vet avoided giving clear explanations and kept pushing unnecessary tests with extra charges. This appears to be their business model.

I took my dog ​​to the vet, and one of their indicators was abnormal. The vet said it would cost over $2000 for tests. I asked him what might be causing it, but he couldn't answer anything and impatiently said there was no other way but to spend more money on tests. I felt his skills were questionable, so I spent more money at Zunchong (I had always heard that Dr. Lin there had a good reputation, but I didn't go there initially because it was far from me and the fees were higher than other places). Dr. Lin asked many questions, examined the dog, deduced the cause, and then treated it. He saved me over $2000, and now my dog ​​is lively and energetic.
That doctor was really rude to my cat. I don’t how he got her DVM or if he really has it or not. They only want to make money. Try their best to charge you more.
Genuinely care about your pet and you.  I was given multiple options for my cats treatment, they were able to follow up with results on the phone so I didn’t worry.  Very happy with this clinic.
Very friendly and caring staff.  Pumpkin received excellent treatment.

Inexperienced vets, lacking problem solving skills or general knowledge, transactional

Don't bother wasting your time, energy or money
My cat has special needs and Alta Vista has always given her the best and kindest service. Highly recommended.
Dr. Tee did a wonderful job taking care of our puppy! She was so compassionate and caring. Olive had a lovely visit!

I credit Alta Vista Animal Hospital for saving my kitten’s life after she was diagnosed with FIP by another vet. The other vet was great too but could not source the required medication. Drs Munjal and Sethi were amazing and able to get her the medication.

They were also so compassionate through the process and have consistently given her thorough exams and evidence based care. The vet assistants there are also great.

Mishti is doing very well now thanks to them - without them she may not be alive now. Also the cost of their services is very good. Would highly recommend them.
All the staff are nice and responsible. Like the clinic!

Staff is amazing! They go above and beyond to help my pets. I have two elderly cats, one diabetic 1 hyperthyroid and it took us a couple of years and numerous different veterinarian offices to finally find Alta vista. They have provided the best care and value available by far in Vancouver. We no longer need to look elsewhere for care .  Sneakers and Bella highly recommend Alta Vista Animal Hospital and so do I.

We’ve had two cats cared for by Dr. Munjal—Pussy Galore and Lady Marmalde—over the past 14+ years. Dr. Munjal and the staff are reponsive and caring, and have provided excellent care to our girls over the years.I highly recommend Alta Vista Animal Hospital.
Our little boy Tucker was seen by Dr Woods I can’t thank all the staff for the wonderful care that was given I would highly recommend this animal HOSP
Caring vet, very fair price. No complaints at all, great service!

10/10

Very friendly and affordable

I've been going to this play since it opened. I'm very pleased with the service that I get. I'm a retired doctor and the head vet listens to my concerns and shares x-rays another results with me. Yesterday my dog got hit by a car in the late afternoon. They stayed open from 5:30 to 6:30 to take her in and do multiple x-rays. I was so relieved to find out that nothing was broken. They gave her excellent care and me a lot of reassurance. I have two cats and two dogs and have always been happy with the service here.
I want to thank the staff for their incredible kindness and sensitivity when my friend had to recently euthanize her dog.  They truly went above and beyond, and if I could give them 10 stars I would.

Great vet office. Friendly and knowledgeable, and give really good medical and training/bonding advice. They sell specialty (vet only) foods, and fulfill prescriptions for pets quickly. Definitely recommend to anyone in the area.

I brought in my foster cat Deedee from VOKRA here on several occasions, and Dr. Munjal and his team were always very kind, responsive, and provided excellent care for her. Deedee had progressive kidney disease and they did everything they could to treat her, make her comfortable, and improve her health and were always accommodating even when it was time to let her go. I’ll always be grateful for the supportive and caring environment they provided for Deedee.
They are wonderful and kind! I have to order prescription food for my senior kitty and they always accommodate
Great straightforward care for both our cat and our dog.
Was recommended from Reddit, sorted by lower reviews and was scared but I had Doctor Holland and he was absolutely great. Will definitely be returning!
Expert care, Kindest staff, Always on time. Very fair pricing on visits recalls and procedures.
Friendly, helpful staff.
Alta vista has always been great with my cat and affordable

I recently took my new pet to see Dr. Munjal, and I couldn't be more impressed! As a first-time pet parent, I had a lot of questions and concerns, but Dr. Munjal took the time to explain everything in detail, making me feel at ease. The clinic was welcoming, and the staff was friendly and professional. Dr. Munjal's knowledge and compassion truly shone through during our visit. I left feeling confident about my pet's care and well-being. Highly recommend!
Friendly staff! Took our family cat here 😺 …
